notes:
- History: every Manage, RMM and AD export the app sees is recorded once (by file content) in `snapshots/history/` next to the program, with file name, file date, hash and the normalized item list. It is local and never in git. A new **History** button shows the timeline; select any two exports of the same kind and **Compare selected** to see Added, Removed, Changed (with the field that changed, such as status or last logon) and Unchanged, filtered by kind and pod, with Copy and Export to Excel. **Latest two** compares the two newest of a kind.
- Two exports of the same kind in the folder (an older and a newer Manage CSV, or two RMM workbooks) now open the History comparison straight away instead of asking for the other export. A new export also shows a one-line note of what moved since the previous one.
- Storage is capped at the newest 50 recorded exports (the **Keep** box in History, saved in `settings.json`). **Clear history** deletes everything after a confirmation.
- Why since-last-run missed this: it only compared the mismatch list between two runs of the same folder, had nothing on the first run, and could not compare two files placed together.
